title: The Appropriation Act, 2004
text:
Legal Supplement Part A to the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette’’, Vol. 42,
No. 163, 30th October, 2003
Second Session Eighth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 27 of 2003
[L.S.]
AN ACT to provide for the Service of Trinidad and Tobago
for the financial year ending on the 30th day of
September, 2004
[Assented to 29th October, 2003]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
Enactment
follows:—
1. This Act may be cited as the Appropriation Act,
Short tile
2004.

104 No. 27 Appropriation 2003
2. (1) The issue from the Consolidated Fund of the
Issue from the
Consolidated Fund sum of sixteen thousand and forty-two million, one
authorized
hundred and sixteen thousand, nine hundred and
thirty-two dollars ($16,042,116,932) is hereby
authorized for meeting expenditure for the service of
the financial year ending on the 30th day of September,
2004 under the Heads of Expenditure specified in the
Schedule Schedule hereto.
(2) The sum specified in the Schedule opposite
to each Head of Expenditure is hereby appropriated
out of the said sum of sixteen thousand, and forty-two
million, one hundred and sixteen thousand, nine
hundred and thirty-two dollars ($16,042,116,932) for
the purpose specified in relation to that Head in the
Estimates of Expenditure for the said financial year.
3. This Act shall be deemed to have come into force
Commencement
on the 1st day of October, 2003.
